ValidationRule.description: To restrict users other than System Admins to change the ownership on the case.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND(
ISCHANGED(OwnerId),
OR( $RecordType.Name = "IM Employees Support Case", $RecordType.Name = "IM Employees Support Case Closed (Locked)", $RecordType.Name = "Sales Tools Project Case", $RecordType.Name = "Sales Tools Project Case Closed (Locked)" ),
NOT( OR( $Profile.Name = "IME_Custom Sys Admin", $Profile.Name = "IMLA_Custom Sys Admin", $Profile.Name = "IM_Custom Sys Admin", $Profile.Name = "IME_Super_User" ) ),
OR( PRIORVALUE(OwnerId) = "00G34000003HgCK", /*IM Employees Support Cases IMNA Queue*/ PRIORVALUE(OwnerId) = "xxxxxxxxxxxxxxx", /*Place Holder for IME */ PRIORVALUE(OwnerId) = "xxxxxxxxxxxxxxx", /*Place Holder for IMLA */ PRIORVALUE(OwnerId) = "xxxxxxxxxxxxxxx", /*Place Holder for IMAP */ PRIORVALUE(OwnerId) = "00G34000003HmXO", /*NA Enhancement Requests*/ PRIORVALUE(OwnerId) = "00G80000001qLVe", /*IM Employees Support Cases Queue*/ OwnerId = "00G34000003HmXO", /*NA Enhancement Requests*/
AND( PRIORVALUE(OwnerId)!= $User.Id, /*Current User does not own the record*/ BEGINS(PRIORVALUE(OwnerId), "005") /*Currently owned by a user, not a queue*/ ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot change the owner of this case. Please contact the Salesforce support team for assistance.
